linesSheWrites.text: You like the build-up. Slow at the start, then let it turn.
linesSheWrites.author: her

linesSheWrites.text: Big presentation on Thursday. You said you were nervous about it.
linesSheWrites.author: her

linesSheWrites.text: Hotel bar, rain outside. You'd just sat down and let the quiet sit.
linesSheWrites.author: her

linesSheWrites.text: We left off with me about to tell you what I'd been thinking before you walked in.
linesSheWrites.author: her

returnLines.text: You came back on the Friday. We picked it up at the bar, same stools, less rain.
returnLines.author: her

rejected.note: Mentioned therapy. Nothing inferred, nothing kept.

slower.text: Slower still. You want it drawn out, not hurried.

more direct.text: When you ask a question, you want a straight answer back.

less talking.text: Fewer words from me. You'd rather I show than tell.

somewhere else.text: You wanted out of the bar. Somewhere with a view.

openers.real: It's Friday. How did Thursday go? I've been wondering since you left.
openers.scene: Still at the hotel bar, or somewhere new tonight? You never did hear what I was going to say.
openers.sceneWithFact: Still at the hotel bar, or somewhere new tonight? And it's Friday. How did Thursday go?
openers.sceneNoFact: Still at the hotel bar, or somewhere new tonight? You never did hear what I was going to say.
openers.realNoFact: You're back. I'd started to wonder if the rain had kept you.
